hooks.prompt: ApexRacers documentation freshness check. Run `git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null || git status --short` to see what changed this turn. If nothing changed under `src/` (the .NET backend projects or `web/` frontend) or in root infra (`docker-compose.yml`, `*.Dockerfile`, `.github/workflows/`), respond 'No source files changed, skipping docs check' and stop immediately. If source files did change, read `.claude/agents/docs-updater.md` and follow its instructions: detect and fix ONLY the documentation drift caused by those specific changes — not a full audit, only the sections relevant to what changed.
